hero.description: For ten years I have designed software and led teams. CTO at Akieni. Before that, I co-founded Cowema.
about.label: ABOUT
about.heading: Leading teams and production systems
about.description_1: I joined Akieni as the first engineer on site. The team grew to 18 engineers, then to a division of 20. Before that, I co-founded Cowema and led the technology for three years, for more than 40,000 users.
about.description_2: Three national platforms are in production: tax, health insurance, and social security. I am also responsible for payments and identity on a public program. In parallel, I lead Akieni Academy, which grew from 30 to 200 learners, with 60% of graduates employed.
about.description_3: I take part in design and code reviews, and I develop in Laravel, Python, TypeScript and C#. To build a team or address a technical matter, write to me.

services.label: SERVICES
services.heading: What I offer
services.description: Advice and implementation, through to production.
services.technical_strategy.title: Technical strategy
services.technical_strategy.subtitle: Architecture
services.technical_strategy.description: Monolith or microservices, a stack change, a migration: I help choose the option that fits the context. I have done this for government agencies, a marketplace of more than 40,000 users, and enterprise platforms.
services.engineering_leadership.title: Engineering management
services.engineering_leadership.subtitle: Team growth
services.engineering_leadership.descript: At Akieni the team grew from 7 to 18 engineers. At Cowema I developed junior engineers to senior level. Relevant when building a first team, or once the organization passes ten people.
services.system_design.title: Architecture and migration
services.system_design.subtitle: From the existing system
services.system_design.description: To modernize an application or prepare a migration, I start from what is already in production. I have split monoliths, and I have kept others intact when splitting them added nothing.
services.fullstack_development.title: Interim CTO
services.fullstack_development.subtitle: Operational work
services.fullstack_development.descripti: I step in as CTO or VP long enough to put the basics in place: hiring, a delivery pace, and the blocked work. The engagement is not limited to presentations.
services.technical_consulting.title: Technical advice
services.technical_consulting.subtitle: Technical opinion
services.technical_consulting.descriptio: When a technical decision is blocked, I review the architecture, examine the code, and recommend the tool. I draw on systems I have already taken to production.
